summary: Active measurements over the public Internet sometimes hit parties who didn't agree to them and may see them as aggressive. This document suggests simple techniques for a probe source to identify itself, explaining what the probe is, its purpose, and who to contact. It relies on offline analysis and needs no changes to the data or control plane.

eli5.summary: If a stranger knocks on your door, you'd like a note saying who they are and why. This says how internet test packets can carry a note like that.
